findings.rationale: The jump security group allows inbound SSH from any internet address, exposing an administrative shell to untrusted networks.
The escalation role trusts an external identity and carries a broad policy attachment, making it directly assumable from the compromised path.
A public SSH ingress on the jump host can chain into an assumable IAM role via STS:AssumeRole, turning network exposure into identity access.
The wildcard IAM policy combined with the bucket's public-read ACL lets the identity path reach publicly exposed object data.
